about: Fixes from checking every unreviewed shown listing against the full-resolution scan (Claude, 2026-10-14). Applied by scripts/build_db.py. A finding is matched by sheet, printed label and the nearest position within 150 px of 'near' (50% image pixels). These are machine-assisted checks, not a person's spot check: listings stay 'not yet checked by a person'.
